piece_knight: This is the knight! It jumps in an L shape.
piece_bishop: This is the bishop! It moves diagonally.
piece_rook: This is the rook! It moves in straight lines.
piece_queen: This is the queen! She is the most powerful piece.
piece_king: This is the king! Protect him at all costs.
board_intro: This is the chess board. It has light and dark squares.
board_intro_squares: Look! The board has light squares and dark squares in a pattern.
board_intro_puzzle_light: Move the king to a light square!
board_intro_puzzle_dark: Move the king to a dark square!
how_chess_intro: In chess, two players take turns. One plays white, the other plays black!
how_chess_turns: Players take turns moving one piece at a time. White always goes first!
how_chess_capture: You can capture an enemy piece by moving to its square! It gets removed from the board.
how_chess_goal: The goal of chess is to trap the opponent's king. That's called checkmate!
how_chess_puzzle_capture: Capture the black pawn! Move your rook to its square.
how_chess_puzzle_capture_2: Capture the black knight with your bishop!
good_but_better: Good idea! But there is an even better move. Try again!
pawn_intro: This is a pawn! The smallest piece, but very brave.
pawn_moves: The pawn moves forward one square.
pawn_first_move: On its first move, the pawn can move two squares.
knight_intro: This is a knight! It looks like a horse.
knight_moves: The knight jumps in an L shape. Two squares one way, then one to the side.
knight_jumps: The knight can jump over other pieces!
knight_puzzle_move: Move the knight to a new square!
knight_puzzle_capture: Capture the pawn with the knight!
bishop_intro: This is a bishop! It has a pointy hat.
bishop_moves: The bishop slides diagonally as far as it wants.
bishop_same_color: The bishop always stays on the same color square!
bishop_puzzle_capture: Capture the pawn with the bishop!
rook_intro: This is a rook! It looks like a castle tower.
rook_moves: The rook moves in straight lines, up, down, left, or right.
rook_moves_horizontal: The rook can also move sideways!
rook_puzzle_move: Move the rook to any square!
rook_puzzle_capture: Capture the pawn with the rook!
queen_intro: This is the queen! She is the most powerful piece on the board.
queen_moves: The queen combines the bishop and the rook. She can move in any direction!
queen_power: The queen is the most powerful piece on the board!
queen_puzzle_move: Move the queen to any square!
queen_puzzle_capture: Capture the pawn with the queen!
king_intro: This is the king! He is the most important piece. Protect him!
king_moves: The king moves one square in any direction.
king_safety: The king cannot move to a square where it would be in danger!
king_danger: Careful! The king cannot go there, it is not safe!
king_puzzle_safe: Find a safe square for the king!
castling_intro: This is a special move called castling.
castling_queenside: You can also castle on the other side! This is queenside castling.
castling_conditions: To castle, the king and rook must not have moved, and the squares between must be empty.
castling_puzzle_kingside: Castle the king to the right side!
castling_puzzle_queenside: Castle the king to the left side!
en_passant_intro: This is a special capture called en passant.
en_passant_capture: When a pawn moves two squares and lands beside your pawn, you can capture it!
en_passant_puzzle_2: Can you capture en passant again?
promotion_intro: When a pawn reaches the other side, it becomes a queen!
promotion_queen: The pawn has become a powerful queen!
promotion_puzzle: Move the pawn to the last row to promote it!
promotion_puzzle_capture: Promote the pawn! You can move forward or capture.
check_intro: Check means the king is under attack!
check_escape_move: When the king is in check, it must escape! It can move to a safe square.
check_escape_block: You can also block a check! Move a piece in the way to protect the king.
check_puzzle_give: Give check to the black king!
checkmate_intro: Checkmate! The king is in check and cannot escape. Game over!
checkmate_vs_check: Remember: checkmate means the king is in check AND has no way out!
checkmate_puzzle_2: Capture the pawn and give checkmate!
piece_values_intro: Some pieces are worth more than others! The queen is the most valuable.
piece_values_order: Queen is worth the most, then the rook, then bishop and knight, and the pawn is worth the least.
piece_values_best_capture: Always try to capture the most valuable piece you can!
piece_values_puzzle: Which piece should you capture? Take the most valuable one!
protecting_intro: Pieces can protect each other! This pawn guards the pawn in front.
protecting_why: If someone takes your pawn, the other pawn can take back! Protected pieces are safe.
protecting_safe_attack: Not just pawns — any piece can protect! This bishop guards the pawn.
protecting_puzzle: Protect your pawn! Move a piece to guard it.
protecting_puzzle_2: Your knight is in danger! Move a piece to protect it.
capstone_intro: You've learned so much! Look at all the pieces you know!
capstone_tips: Use everything you've learned: move your pieces, protect them, and attack!
stalemate_intro: Sometimes a game ends in a draw. This is called stalemate!
stalemate_trapped: If it's a player's turn but they have no legal moves and are NOT in check — that's stalemate. The game is a draw!
stalemate_puzzle_avoid: Be careful! Move the queen so the black king isn't stalemated.
stalemate_puzzle_checkmate: Can you checkmate the king without causing a stalemate?
stalemate_oops: Oops! That causes a stalemate. The king has no moves but isn't in check!
fork_intro: A fork attacks two pieces at once!
fork_explain: The knight attacks both the king and the rook! The king must move, and the knight captures the rook.
fork_puzzle: Find the fork! Attack two pieces with the knight!
pin_intro: A pin traps a piece because it shields the king.
pin_explain: The bishop pins the rook! The rook cannot move because the king is behind it.
pin_puzzle: Find the pin and capture the pinned piece!
pin_puzzle_2: Can you capture the pinned piece?
puzzle_pawn_move_1: Move the pawn forward! It can go two squares on its first move.
puzzle_pawn_move_2: Move the pawn forward one square!
puzzle_pawn_capture: The pawn captures diagonally! Capture the enemy pawn.
puzzle_pawn_promote: Move the pawn to the last row to become a queen!
puzzle_pawn_promote_capture: Capture the piece and promote your pawn!
puzzle_knight_move: Move the knight! Remember, it jumps in an L shape.
puzzle_knight_capture: Capture the piece with your knight!
puzzle_knight_fork: Find the knight fork! Attack two pieces at once.
puzzle_bishop_capture: Capture the piece with your bishop!
puzzle_rook_move: Move the rook! It goes in straight lines.
puzzle_rook_capture: Capture the piece with your rook!
puzzle_queen_capture: Capture the piece with your queen!
puzzle_queen_best_move: Find the best move for the queen! Capture the most valuable piece.
puzzle_king_move: Move the king one square in any direction!
puzzle_king_safe: Move the king to a safe square! Avoid danger.
puzzle_tactic_fork: Find the fork! Attack two pieces at once.
puzzle_tactic_pin: Find the pin! Trap the piece against the king.
try_tap_hint: Tap the piece, then tap where it goes!
puzzle_instruction: Tap a piece and then its destination.
piku_intro_greeting: Hi {name}! I'm Piku! Let's learn chess together!
onboarding_start: This is your chess adventure! Tap the green circle to start!
landing_hero_speech: Hi! I'm Piku! Let's learn chess!
landing_hero_subtitle: Learn chess from the very first move — voice-guided, no reading needed! Ages 3–6.
landing_feature_1_desc: Start with the pawn, then unlock new pieces. Piku teaches every move with animations and voice.
landing_feature_2_desc: 100+ puzzles sorted by piece. Tap the right square and earn stars!
landing_feature_3_desc: Three difficulty levels that grow with your child. Piku cheers them on!
landing_trust_title: Made for tiny hands, trusted by parents
landing_footer: Made with love for little chess players
celebrate_all_complete: You completed all the lessons! You're a chess champion!
celebrate_champion_reward: You earned the Champion Crown and Cape!
chest_appeared: Look! A treasure chest! Tap it to open!
stuck_nudge: Good game! Want to play again?
watch_first: Watch first! It's Piku's turn to show you.
game_over_loss: Good game! Want to try again?
delete_warning: This will permanently delete all players and progress. This cannot be undone.
delete_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
